spec.why: Clause 14d, no super-linear curve (wave 10, lane 10A). The least-squares log-log slope of every timed op's p50 over the five tiers is held at 1.1: linear, plus a stated allowance for timing noise over a 50x range (doubling the library may cost at most 2^1.1 = 2.14x). The last segment, 25k -> 50k, is held on its own at 1.3, because a curve that bends up at the top is the symptom the clause names and a five-point fit dilutes it; a two-point slope over a 2x range carries about twice the fit's noise, so its allowance is wider. Both set BEFORE the curve was measured; never raised to fit a reading. An op missing at any tier, or a tier not run, is a breach.
